en.description:
CalcMaster is the only calculator you need on your phone. One polished app, ten unit categories, five calculator modes, eight finance tools, nine utilities, and a notes pad — all designed for travelers, students, freelancers, and anyone who does the math.

—— What you can do ——

CONVERT (10 categories)
Distance · Volume · Weight · Temperature · Speed · Area · Data Size · Fuel Economy · Pressure · Energy. Tap any category, type a value, and instantly see every other unit. Big accent-tinted result + a complete cross-reference list.

CALCULATE (5 modes)
Standard four-function · Scientific (sin / cos / tan / log / ln / √ / x^y / n!) · Percentage (X% of Y, % change, increase/decrease) · Base converter (binary / octal / decimal / hex) · Fraction (add, subtract, multiply, divide, simplify, mixed numbers).

FINANCE (8 tools)
Income tax estimates from published brackets for 11 regions (US, UK, EU, Canada, Australia, India, Japan, Brazil, Mexico, South Korea, UAE), with US filing statuses and standard deductions · Paycheck / take-home pay · Sales tax / VAT · Tip & split, starting from each region's customary tip · Discount · Compound interest with optional monthly contributions · EMI / loan payments · Currency conversion with European Central Bank reference rates, cached for offline use · Unit-price comparison.

TOOLS (9 utilities)
GPS coordinates (decimal ↔ DMS) with one-tap "Use my location" · Ohm's Law solver from any two of V, I, R, P · BMI with healthy-range bands · Date difference · World time zones · ADC / DAC voltage ↔ digital code · Age calculator · Aspect ratio · Calendar (month view, ISO week, day-of-year).

NOTES
Save calculations, formulas, and reminders. Search, edit, delete. Notes are stored only on this device and are never synced.

—— Why CalcMaster ——

• Region-aware. Tap the flag in the header to switch between 11 regions: US, UK, EU, CA, AU, IN, JP, BR, MX, KR and AE. Currency, sales-tax defaults, the customary tip and income-tax brackets all update live. On first launch the region follows your device's region setting.

• Beautiful, dark, and fast. Hand-authored line-art icons, neon accents per category, and instant results.

• Privacy. Every calculation runs on your device, you never need an account, and we don't sell your data. The app connects to: Frankfurter (api.frankfurter.dev) for European Central Bank exchange rates; Supabase, only if you choose to create an account or sign in (email, Apple or Google); Firebase Crashlytics, Analytics and Performance Monitoring, for crash reports and app usage and performance statistics; and your device's location service plus the Apple or Google geocoder, only when you tap Detect my location in the region picker or Use my location in the GPS tool. This version shows no ads.

• Offline ready. Convert, calculate, and budget without a signal. Currency rates are cached on the device and refresh the next time you open the app online or tap refresh.

• Consistent and precise. The same calculations and the same answers every time.

—— CalcMaster Pro ——

Optional purchase that unlocks year-by-year breakdowns in the loan (EMI) and compound-interest calculators — principal, interest and balance for every year — and supports development. Choose monthly, annual, or a one-time lifetime purchase; prices are shown in the app in your local currency.

Cancel a subscription any time from your device's subscription settings.

—— Built for ——

• Travelers calculating tips and currency conversions abroad
• Freelancers estimating taxes after every invoice
• Students checking unit conversions and physics formulas
• Engineers solving voltage drops and ADC resolution
• Cooks scaling recipes between metric and imperial
• Anyone tired of juggling six different apps to do the math

Download CalcMaster and replace your stock calculator. We think you'll like it.

en.release_notes:
Hello, world! This is the first release of CalcMaster.

Highlights of this build:
• 10 unit converters, 5 calculator modes, 8 finance tools, 9 utilities, and a notes pad
• Calendar tool: month view with ISO week, day-of-year, and quarter
• Region-aware tax, currency and customary tips for 11 regions
• European Central Bank exchange rates, cached for offline use
• Beautiful dark theme with hand-authored line-art icons
• Optional CalcMaster Pro: year-by-year loan and investment breakdowns

We'd love to hear from you. Tap Settings → Send feedback to reach the team.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
CalcMaster is the only calculator you need on your phone. One polished app, ten unit categories, five calculator modes, eight finance tools, nine utilities, and a notes pad — all designed for travelers, students, freelancers, and anyone who does the math.

Intended audience:
World calculator & converter

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on the calculator (Calculate tab) after a short splash screen; it does not open on a sign-in screen. An account is optional and no feature requires one. To sign in: Convert tab > gear icon (Settings) > Account > Sign in. The demo account is provided only so you can test sign-in and in-app account deletion. On first launch, once the first screen has rendered, the app shows the iOS App Tracking Transparency prompt. This build has no live ad units, so no ad is ever requested and the Google Mobile Ads SDK is not started. CalcMaster Pro (in-app purchase) unlocks the year-by-year breakdown tables under the EMI and Compound interest results (Finance tab). The paywall opens from Settings > Subscription > Subscribe to Pro, or from the locked "Year-by-year breakdown" card on those two screens.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Supabase — optional account sign-in and in-app account deletion
- Sign in with Apple (iOS) and Google Sign-In (Android) — optional authentication
- Frankfurter (api.frankfurter.dev) — European Central Bank exchange rates
- Firebase Crashlytics, Analytics and Performance Monitoring — crash reports and usage statistics
- Apple In-App Purchase — CalcMaster Pro
- Device location and the platform geocoder — only when the user taps Detect my location in the region picker or Use my location in the GPS tool
- Google Mobile Ads SDK — included, but not started in this build (no live ad units)
- Google AdMob (ads): banner and occasional interstitial ads served by Google. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure ads; the app does not track users across other companies' apps or websites. Where required (EEA, UK, Switzerland) consent is requested before any ad, and the choice can be changed under Privacy choices in the app.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Account deletion is in the app: sign in, then Convert tab > gear icon (Settings) > Account > Delete account, and confirm with Delete permanently.

differentiation:
1. WHAT IT DOES
CalcMaster is the only calculator you need on your phone. One polished app, ten unit categories, five calculator modes, eight finance tools, nine utilities, and a notes pad — all designed for travelers, students, freelancers, and anyone who does the math.
Screens it contains: about, auth, calculate, convert detail, convert home, diagnostics, finance, notes, paywall, privacy policy, settings

2. INTENDED USER
People who do everyday numbers across several kinds of calculation and would otherwise keep separate apps for them: unit conversion in ten categories, scientific, percentage, base and fraction calculation, and finance tools such as tax estimates for 11 regions, take-home pay, tips, loans and currency conversion at ECB reference rates. In practice that means students, travellers converting units and currency, and freelancers estimating tax and pay. Notes stay on the device for anyone who wants to keep a calculation.

3. GAP IT FILLS

4. BETA TESTING DONE
Measured from App Store Connect on 2026-10-12 (GET only; docs/beta-evidence.json):
  - TestFlight builds uploaded: 8 (8 processed), first 2026-08-17, last 2026-10-12

  - Beta App Review submissions (needed before external testers get a build): 1 (1 REJECTED), last 2026-09-21
  - Recorded across all builds, last 365 days: 8 installs, 58 sessions, 0 crashes

5. STANDALONE OR PART OF A SUITE
Part of a suite: 43 apps are published under this developer account.
Category: UTILITIES.

This app's scope differs from the rest measurably, not just by description:

  - Screens unique to it: calculate, convert detail, convert home, diagnostics, finance, notes, privacy policy
  - Closest other app by implementation: PilotEnRoute at 29%
    similarity of non-generic widget and class usage
  - Across all 43 apps the median pairwise similarity is 12%, and
    no pair exceeds 85%

Both numbers exclude the ~60 widgets every Flutter app uses — Column, Text,
Padding and so on. Including them makes any two Flutter apps look 97% alike,
which is a property of the framework rather than of these apps.

The store copy is distinct on the same basis: no two of the 43 share more
than 22% of their description vocabulary.

6. COULD THIS BE AN IN-APP PURCHASE IN ANOTHER APP

Proposed (owner to confirm): No. Measured overlap with each app in the category: AGCleaner: 0 screen name(s) in common, 9% implementation similarity; AGRecorder: 0 screen name(s) in common, 12% implementation similarity; MyCard: 2 screen name(s) in common (auth, settings), 10% implementation similarity; PlantPulse: 1 screen name(s) in common (settings), 9% implementation similarity; Uscis-Case: 0 screen name(s) in common, 13% implementation similarity; WiFiTrail: 0 screen name(s) in common, 9% implementation similarity; iMeasure: 2 screen name(s) in common (settings, splash), 10% implementation similarity.

7. CODE SHARED WITH OUR OTHER APPS
Yes, infrastructure only: agl_ads (ad mediation); agl_observability (crash reporting); agl_i18n (shared translations). It also uses the same Supabase project as our other apps for sign-in. No screens, features or content are shared; the similarity figure in 5 measures exactly that.

8. CODE SHARED WITH THIRD-PARTY APPS
No, beyond standard third-party frameworks: flutter_localizations, flutter_svg, google_fonts, google_mobile_ads, google_sign_in, in_app_purchase, sign_in_with_apple, supabase_flutter.
